1.details:
Set up core infrastructure components:
1. Deploy Redis with proper database separation (predictions, agent memory, graph state)
2. Deploy Letta server with PostgreSQL and Redis integration
3. Set up Abacus.AI ML pipeline (feature groups, model training, deployment)
4. Configure QuantConnect LEAN custom data ingestion for Abacus.AI predictions
5. Test basic API integrations between components

2.details:
Build multi-agent coordination system:
1. Create LangGraph workflow with state management and Redis checkpointing
2. Build CrewAI agent crew with specialized roles (market research, ML engineering, risk management, execution)
3. Integrate Letta stateful agents with memory blocks for persistent learning
4. Implement Redis pub/sub for real-time agent communication
5. Test agent handoffs and decision-making workflows

3.details:
Connect external tools and build API layer:
1. Set up Composio MCP server with required tools (GitHub, Slack, broker APIs)
2. Build LangGraph API service with workflow endpoints
3. Create ASYMEdge dashboard API with agent query interfaces
4. Integrate Letta REST API for memory queries and updates
5. Implement authentication and rate limiting

4.details:
Deploy complete system with container orchestration:
1. Build production Docker Compose configuration with all services
2. Configure service dependencies and health checks
3. Set up environment variables and secrets management
4. Deploy ASYMEdge dashboard frontend
5. Test end-to-end data flow: Market data → ML → Agents → Trade execution

5.details:
Production readiness and monitoring:
1. Implement comprehensive error handling and retry logic
2. Add monitoring with Prometheus/Grafana
3. Set up backup and disaster recovery procedures
4. Performance optimization and scaling configuration
5. Security audit and compliance checks
